accepted.sql: select sum(c.claim_approved_amount) from beneficiaries b join medical_cases m on m.beneficiary_pk=b.beneficiary_pk join claims c on c.case_pk=m.case_pk where b.district_name='Amritsar' and b.aadhaar_status='VERIFIED' and b.beneficiary_pk in (select m2.beneficiary_pk from medical_cases m2 where m2.case_status in ('APPROVED'))

select sum(c.claim_approved_amount) from beneficiaries b join medical_cases m on m.beneficiary_pk=b.beneficiary_pk join claims c on c.case_pk=m.case_pk where b.district_name='Amritsar' and b.aadhaar_status='VERIFIED' and b.beneficiary_pk in (select m2.beneficiary_pk from medical_cases m2 where m2.case_status in ('APPROVED')) and c.case_status in ('APPROVED')

select sum(c.claim_approved_amount) from beneficiaries b join medical_cases m on m.beneficiary_pk=b.beneficiary_pk join claims c on c.case_pk=m.case_pk where b.district_name='Amritsar' and b.aadhaar_status='VERIFIED' and b.beneficiary_pk in (select m2.beneficiary_pk from medical_cases m2 where m2.case_status in ('APPROVED','DISBURSED'))

select sum(c.claim_approved_amount) from beneficiaries b join medical_cases m on m.beneficiary_pk=b.beneficiary_pk join claims c on c.case_pk=m.case_pk where b.district_name='Amritsar' and b.aadhaar_status='VERIFIED' and b.beneficiary_pk in (select m2.beneficiary_pk from medical_cases m2 where m2.case_status in ('APPROVED','DISBURSED')) and c.case_status in ('APPROVED','DISBURSED')
